welcome: A clear space for your next discovery.

seed_notes.title: Start with a question
seed_notes.body:
What happens at the boundary between a browser and a server?

Record an observation, keep the exact request, and test your explanation. This notebook is your private working space.

seed_notes.title: The research trail
seed_notes.body:
A useful finding tells a complete story: the trigger, the impact, the cause, and the fix.

Keep source links and reproduction steps beside your observations.

seed_notes.title: Before the next session
seed_notes.body:
Review the threat model.
Reproduce one finding.
Explain the fix to a teammate.
Record what remains uncertain.
